name: Mia Gobble
headline: Producer & Generalist Developer
about:
Since I was 10 years old I have had an undying passion for game development across multiple disciplines. I've always had my eyes set on the full picture of projects; I conceptualize, produce, release, and maintain games with the vision of making truly great games that people care about.

I've had excellent opportunities during my career so far, previously running a very successful studio (Iconic Gaming), and now starting up a new one (Oxomo Games). I've also worked for massive projects with billions of play sessions and up to hundreds of thousands of concurrent players. My own projects kept loyal playerbases for years!

My employers have always recognized my strengths: pragmatic leadership and development that knows how to stick to roadmaps and deadlines. That being said, I would consider myself excellent at taking calculated risks to make mechanically and stylistically unique projects that feel fresh to newly discovered audiences.
